objective: Establish WRASAL Visual DNA Conformance Harness v001 as a governed execution boundary between canonical visual rules, specimens, and rendered artifact review.
success_condition: A deterministic harness ingests artifact observation manifests, separates canonical from inferred checks, runs the blind WRASAL test, records negative and unsupported decisions, and emits repeat-failure candidates without promoting specimens or inferred rules to canon.

evidence.observed_result: Control-plane validation, existing validator tests, and passing/failing conformance fixture tests all passed.
The harness requires logo, typography, metadata, coordinates, and gold/red indicators to be removed and requires a passing evaluator rationale before the blind test can pass.
Repeated failures produce review-only v002 candidates; specimens and inferred rules are not automatically promoted to canon.

next_candidate: Ingest actual rendered or photographed specimen outputs and review recurring failures before proposing any v002 change.
